title: ToDoList
tagline: its demo of to do list application to run in solidity. to store and delete task of clients
description: its a simple app to do dapp using solidity truffle and react typescript This project combines a state channels hub and browser-based frontend to allow users to create and delete to manage their task. its usefull if allthing be in web3. its just an idea. get and set task for client in unix time.
how_its_made:
i use solidity version over 8.3  for smartcontracts for web3 and react for frontend to interact with smartcontracts and truffle. and also use web3modal and web3js library to interact with function of smartcontract. . front end is base nodejs by react framework.   
This project combines a state channels hub and browser-based frontend to allow users to create and delete to manage their task. its usefull if allthing be in web3. its just an idea. get and set task for client in unix time
